en.title: No Pairs Allowed
en.description:
You are given n words of lowercase English letters. In each word, any character may be replaced with any lowercase English letter. Find the minimum number of replacements so that the final string has no two equal adjacent characters.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site and does not represent standard input/output given by the original problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤100), followed by n lines each with one word; 2≤length of each word≤100000, and all characters are a–z.
en.output: Output the minimum number of replacements for each word in input order, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying solution for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First identify which objects can be swapped or modified, then observe how local operations affect the overall result.
